summary: Woman veteran hiker on a Huts for Vets group day hike rolled her ankle and somersaulted down a slope near Margy's Hut; severe ankle injury with tendons/ligaments torn and open wound; litter carry to hut then Flight for Life helicopter evac to hospital
location: Sawmill Park trail near Margy's Hut, Hunter-Fryingpan Wilderness
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen + Flight for Life
notes: Victim Terri, participant in the first Huts for Vets women veterans program; a Mountain Rescue Aspen member on the 10th Mountain Huts crew was at the hut and initiated the rescue; published Aug 10, 2014 by Aspen Journalism in collaboration with The Aspen Times.
